tickets.title: Synergy detection and firing rules
tickets.description: Resolve in priority order (Cataclysm×Law → Cataclysm×Powers → Law×Powers → Pressure → Anomaly), cap at two active per seed, stop checking once two fire.

tickets.title: Synergy override pipeline
tickets.description: A fired synergy overrides default flavour text and injects its faction, dungeon type and world name into WorldConfig.

tickets.title: Two-tier synergy content model
tickets.description: Tier 1 gets faction + dungeon type + mechanic; Tier 2 is text-only. Most players never know which they got.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Silence + Blood-price (Tithe-houses)
tickets.description: No animals means no animal blood. Bottled vitality as currency, Tithe-houses vs defenceless free cities.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Drowning + Ore-bound (dive guilds)
tickets.description: Ore under 200m of water. Diving as a progression axis, pressurised wrecks, air management, dive-guild faction.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Gods Died + Borrowed (the Auditors)
tickets.description: The gods were the lenders, killed to void the debt. Casting is traceable and draws collection.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Gods Died + Theocracy (the Custodians)
tickets.description: The church knows and administers rituals to a corpse. Information-control thriller as the main line.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Silence + Occupation (the invaders' animals)
tickets.description: The only living beasts belong to the occupiers. A horse on the horizon means enemy, with no UI. Cheap and evocative.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Drowning + Merchant compacts (trade as life support)
tickets.description: Nothing grows; all food imported. The player can starve or save a settlement by touching its shipping.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Dying + Merchant compacts (inflating economy)
tickets.description: The compacts corner remaining charges. Prices climb measurably over campaign time.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Nothing Broke + Dying (the conspiracy)
tickets.description: The golden age is quietly ending and the people who know are lying. Tonal inversion — intrigue, not survival.

tickets.title: Tier 2 synergy pool: Pressure combinations
tickets.description: Drowning+Splitting, Written+Blight, Borrowed+Returning, Silence+Wakening, Ore-bound+Rival. Text-only, an afternoon each.

tickets.title: Tier 3 synergy pool: Anomaly combinations
tickets.description: Immortal witness + Gods Died, Second layer + Sundering, Two moons + Ley-bound, and others. Rare jackpot identity.

tickets.title: Triple synergies
tickets.description: ~1% of seeds. Gods Died + Borrowed + Returning, Silence + Blood-price + Hunger, Drowning + Ore-bound + Compacts.
